task: Descript official fallback artifact static inventory and bounded worklet analysis

version.note: Old May 2025 build served by official legacy fallback; not represented as current Descript.

provenance.fallback_discovery: Parent statically found https://web.descript.com/download embedded in Descript Installer 2.2.0 (15), at binary offsets 0xd060d and 0x20aebd. HEAD of that exact endpoint resolved the payload below.
provenance.network: Public authenticated-free GET ranges with verified Content-Range and retained headers. Interrupted ranges resumed; no account, trial, purchase or target launch.

limitations: CommonJS and ESM binding relationships were recovered from inert syntax and resolved only within the inventoried artifact container.
JavaScript and HTML were parsed as inert text; bundle bootstrap code was never executed.
Static imports, entrypoints, workers, endpoints, and storage relationships do not prove runtime execution.
Static paths and relationships may remain unresolved when expressions are dynamic or obfuscated.
Webpack/Rspack factories were recovered from AST literals; REA did not invoke push handlers or bundle bootstrap code.
rea.scope_note: REA analyzed only the directory containing the two selected worklets; complete artifact graph refers to this subset only. Semantic graph is partial due to explicit node ceilings. Findings also use direct inert-source reading with byte ranges.

findings.title: RMS noise gate with five states
findings.observation: The shipped noise-gate worklet computes RMS for an input channel, compares it with a threshold, and transitions among Closed, Opening, Open, Holding and Closing. Its gain helper applies linear ramps during opening and closing.
findings.limit: This establishes a conventional gate implementation in one packaged worklet; no measured audio quality, runtime reachability, Studio Sound algorithm, or neural denoiser is established.

findings.title: Gate controls and timing assumption
findings.observation: Parameter descriptors expose threshold (default 0.1, range 0..1), attack (default 1 ms, range 0.1..10), hold (default 1 ms, range 0.1..100), release (default 100 ms, range 50..500), all k-rate. The process method converts these times using an explicit 44100 constant. A GainReduction message returns the gate state.
findings.limit: The selected files do not establish how the parent graph chooses its sample rate, resamples audio, or connects this worklet. The 44100 constant alone is not evidence of a product bug.

findings.title: Transcription capture buffers PCM16 on the first input channel
findings.observation: The transcription-processor uses a 131072-byte ArrayBuffer and reads the first channel of the first input. It converts float samples to signed PCM16 little-endian, transfers audio buffers with timeOffset and isDone, reports first-frame and no-data, and flushes a buffer when receiving stop. Each send advances timeOffset by 131072 / sampleRate / 2.
findings.limit: This is capture and buffer transport code, not a speech recognition model, enhancement model, export pipeline, or proof of upload destination. The stop path sends the allocated buffer; downstream handling of the partially filled tail was not inspected.

findings.title: Shipped native media dependency
findings.observation: package.json declares beamcoder via beamcoder-prebuild 0.7.1-rc.18. The app contains beamcoder.node (x86_64 and arm64) and FFmpeg-family shared libraries. The main app executable is x86_64. Electron Framework Info.plist reports 20.0.2.
findings.limit: Package membership and manifest declarations do not prove which processing or export path uses this dependency.
